description_en: Queries the monitoring and alerting settings of a change tracking instance
description_zh: 查询数据订阅实例的监控报警设置详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-subscription-instance-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsl8zl9ek62920000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSubscriptionInstanceAlert

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

DelayAlertPhone.description_en: The mobile phone number of the contact for latency alerts
DelayAlertPhone.description_zh: 延迟报警的联系人手机号码

DelayAlertStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether latency alerting is enabled. Valid values:

enable: Enabled.
disable: Disabled
DelayAlertStatus.description_zh:
是否监控延迟状态，返回值：

enable：是。
disable：否

DelayOverSeconds.description_en: The threshold for triggering latency alerts. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer. A value of 10 seconds is recommended
DelayOverSeconds.description_zh: 触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒且需为整数，建议取值为10秒

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

ErrorAlertPhone.description_en: The mobile phone number of the contact for error alerts
ErrorAlertPhone.description_zh: 异常报警的联系人手机号码

ErrorAlertStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether error alerting is enabled. Valid values:

enable: Enabled.
disable: Disabled
ErrorAlertStatus.description_zh:
是否监控异常状态，返回值：

enable：是。
disable：否

SubscriptionInstanceName.description_en: The name of the change tracking instance

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
